what: Ba dot bien tren ban sao de chung minh rang co rang
detail: 1) guard luon DO (failures.length===0 -> false): clean/ledger-paired/superseded-paired/supersede-source-single FAIL, adr-uncited/ledger-missing PASS. 2) kiem B chet (heirs=null): superseded-bare/superseded-paired/supersede-source-single FAIL, clean PASS. 3) kiem C chet (vong lap rong): ledger-missing/ledger-stale FAIL, ledger-paired/clean PASS. Moi kiem duoc phan biet boi mot tap con RIENG cua case.

what: KHONG noi guard vao CI trong PR nay
detail: scripts/ci/check-action-pins.sh dem so SITE pin actions/checkout chu khong dat san, nen them mot job CI lam guard DO vi ly do khong lien quan. Noi day la PR hai-file rieng kem bump so site. Da ghi trong Out of scope.

what: Vong 2: dot bien CHI lam ngheo THONG DIEP, khong doi hanh vi do/xanh
detail: M-A bo tieu de khoi thong diep A -> adr-uncited FAIL (clean van PASS). M-B bo trich dan khoi thong diep B -> superseded-bare FAIL (superseded-paired van PASS). M-C bo ten slug khoi hai thong diep C -> ledger-missing + ledger-stale FAIL (ledger-paired van PASS). Ca ba truoc khi va deu XANH vi guard van thoat khac 0 y het.

what: Vong 2: M-D alias khai dung + tro dung file + CHAY HONG
detail: Them `exit 1` vao check-roadmap-fresh.sh: nua (a) khai bao van XANH, nua (b) thuc thi DO va goi ten dung alias. Chung minh nua (b) khong phai trang tri.

what: Vong 3: hai lo fail-open duong ria da dong
detail: T-1 go chuoi vien dan khoi MOI file trong duong quet -> guard DO dung nhanh quet-rong (truoc do in ✅ exit 0, da tai hien). T-2 doi ten file + tro lai package.json tren ban sao cay DAY DU -> tu nhan dien qua realpath dung, bo qua dung, exit 0, khong treo (truoc do self_alias rong -> de quy). T-3 doi chung tren cay that: exit 0. Ba phep thu dau tien cua may dung SAI (T-1 chi go chuoi o mot file; timeout khong co tren macOS; probe toi gian thieu docs/ nen do oan) - da lam lai.
